coach.headline: Welcome. Try the loop once with the example lesson.
coach.body: Open Lesson 01, answer the three exercises from memory, press Submit answers, then tell Claude "check my inbox". When you're ready for a real topic, say /teach and what you want to learn.

voices.text: Fifteen minutes, three questions, one submit. That's the whole loop.
New face. The first round is on the house. The first lesson too.

topics.title: How learning works

milestones.title: Study like the research says
milestones.goal: Explain storage vs retrieval strength without notes

steps.title: Recall check, a few days later

queue.label: Lesson 01
queue.title: Retrieval beats rereading
queue.why: The idea every later lesson is built on, and a 15-minute way to try the whole loop: read, answer from memory, submit, get graded.

submit.intro: Close the lesson first and answer from memory. Short is fine.
fields: 1. Retrieval strength vs storage strength, in your own words
2. Why can rereading feel better while working worse?
3. One way you'll practise retrieval this week, on something you're learning

queue.label: Probe 01
queue.title: How you study now
queue.why: Measures your starting habits so lessons aim at what helps most. Nothing to study first.
queue.rules: Answer from memory and honestly. No looking things up.

submit.intro: Copy each answer in. "I don't know" is a fine answer.
fields: 1. What you do after reading something you want to remember
2. Last time you tested yourself without looking
3. Something you studied hard and forgot: how you studied it
4. Usual session length and how often
5. What you want to learn next, and why

queue.label: Recall check
queue.title: Storage vs retrieval strength, cold
queue.why: A few days after lesson 01, closed book. If you can still explain it, it's yours.
queue.unlock: Opens a few days after lesson 01 is graded. Ask Claude then.
